info.title: Podcast
info.description: Podcast links to wiki pages. Find takes any podcast link (a feed, BBC, Apple Podcasts, ListenNotes, a show's website) or a title and finds the podcast's open RSS feed. Page builds a podcast page or an episode page from that feed, for the browser to show as a ghost page to fork. Both reach the public internet and spend the farm's ListenNotes quota, so only the signed-in owner of a private site may call them, and they are never offered to agents.

post.summary: Find a podcast's open feed from a link or a title
post.description: Answers with how the feed was found (route, steps), a summary of the podcast and its 25 newest episodes, and the episode the link named, if any. An ambiguous title answers with candidates.

input.description: A podcast or episode link, or a podcast title.

title.description: Optional title hint, for pages that carry several podcasts.

200.description: The finder's result and a podcast summary.

post.summary: Build a podcast or episode page from a feed
post.description: Answers with page JSON (title, story, journal) built from the feed: the podcast page, or with episode set, that episode's page. Nothing is written to the wiki; the browser shows it as a ghost page.

feedUrl.description: The feed, as find answered it.

episode.description: An episode key (its guid or audio URL) from find. Omit for the podcast page.

found.description: Find's facts to record on the page: route, itunesId, listennotesId, movedFrom.

recent.description: How many recent episodes the podcast page lists (1-50, default 10).
